title: NOC Dashboard Wall v34 — PostgreSQL RDS

targets.rawSql: SELECT date AS time, s1_interface_failures AS s1_interface_failures, rrc_success_rate AS rrc_success_rate FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, network_trouble_tickets_open AS network_trouble_tickets_open, customer_trouble_tickets_open AS customer_trouble_tickets_open, provisioning_success_rate AS provisioning_success_rate, (network_trouble_tickets_open - customer_trouble_tickets_open) AS resolved_today, network_trouble_tickets_open AS network_trouble_tickets_open, sla_compliance AS sla_compliance, session_establishment_network_success_rate AS session_establishment_network_success_rate, (100 - end_to_end_availability) / 100.0 AS system_downtime FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, attach_success_rate AS attach_success_rate, service_request_success_rate AS service_request_success_rate, paging_success_rate AS paging_success_rate, eps_bearer_setup_success_rate AS eps_bearer_setup_success_rate, eps_bearer_drop_rate AS eps_bearer_drop_rate, (100 - tau_success_rate) AS congestion_rate, mme_cpu_utilization AS peak_utilization FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, alarm_storm_detection AS scff_status, sip_5xx_error_rate AS sip_overload, call_drop_rate_of_ims_mo AS call_drop_rate, max_registered_users AS max_registered_users FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, (mttr / 60.0) AS mttr_hrs, (100 - (mean_alarm_acknowledgment_time / 90.0 * 100)) AS ack_rate, sla_compliance AS sla_compliance FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, online_users AS fred_sirs, critical_alarms_count AS critical_alarms_count, ran_active_alarms AS ran_active_alarms, suppressed_alarms_count AS suppressed_alarms_count, sites_85_prb AS sites_85_prb, transport_links_80_util AS transport_links_80_util FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

targets.rawSql: SELECT date AS time, sip_registration_sr AS sip_registration_sr, mo_session_connection_rate AS mo_session_connection_rate FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, mt_session_connection_rate AS mt_session_connection_rate, call_setup_time_ms AS call_setup_time_ms, call_drop_rate_of_ims_mo AS call_drop_rate, total_traffic_mo_mt_erl AS traffic_erl, max_registered_users AS max_registered_users FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, iot_ul_message_success_rate AS iot_ul_message_success_rate, iot_dl_message_success_rate AS iot_dl_message_success_rate, iot_rach_success_rate AS iot_rach_success_rate FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, (5000 - affected_sites * 10) AS normal_sites, ran_active_alarms AS live_nodes, site_down AS site_down FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, online_users AS online_users, total_number_of_lte_connected_subs AS total_number_of_lte_connected_subs, mcptt_setup_time AS mcptt_setup_time, total_number_of_wifi_connected_subs AS total_number_of_wifi_connected_subs, (CAST(mc_push_to_talk_success AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(mc_push_to_talk_attempts,0) * 100) AS ptt_sr, session_establishment_network_success_rate AS session_establishment_network_success_rate FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, 0 AS vswr_attention, s1_interface_failures AS mobility_failures, s1_success_rate AS inter_lte_ho_sr, s1_resets AS sector_down_count FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, (100 - e_rab_success_rate) AS e_rab_drop_rate, (100 - e_rab_success_rate) AS e_rab_drop_rate, volte_drop_rate AS volte_drop_rate, site_down AS site_down FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, site_down AS site_down, links_down AS links_down, suppressed_alarms_count AS suppressed_alarms_count, ran_active_alarms AS ran_active_alarms FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, customer_trouble_tickets_open AS sla_breach_count, (mean_alarm_clearance_time / 24.0) AS resolution_time_hrs FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, sms_submission_success_rate AS sms_submission_success_rate, (100 - smsc_cpu_usage) AS smsc_availability FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date AS time, transport_latency AS transport_latency, transport_packet_loss AS transport_packet_loss, transport_jitter AS transport_jitter, backhaul_availability AS bandwidth, 4.2 AS throughput_gbps, (100 - transport_packet_loss) AS link_utilization, links_down AS links_down FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, sms_delivery_success_rate FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT volte_drop_rate AS "VoLTE Drop", e_rab_success_rate AS "E-RAB SR", end_to_end_availability AS "RAN Avail", rrc_success_rate AS "RRC SR", s1_success_rate AS "S1 SR", volte_cssr AS "VoLTE CSSR" FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT date AS time, emergency_call_success_rate FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT
  "date" AS time,
  end_to_end_availability
FROM public.data_sample
WHERE $__timeFilter("date")
ORDER BY "date" DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT date AS time, mc_push_to_talk_attempts AS "PTT Attempts" FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, intra_lte_ho_success_rate FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, intra_lte_ho_success_rate AS "HO SR" FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT
  "date" AS time,
  sla_compliance
FROM public.data_sample
WHERE $__timeFilter("date")
ORDER BY "date" DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT date AS time, end_to_end_availability FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, sla_compliance FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, end_to_end_availability AS ran_availability FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, backhaul_availability FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT
  "date" AS time,
  critical_alarms_count
FROM public.data_sample
WHERE $__timeFilter("date")
ORDER BY "date" DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT date AS time, transport_latency FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT
  "date" AS time,
  affected_sites
FROM public.data_sample
WHERE $__timeFilter("date")
ORDER BY "date" DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT date AS time, (100 - sla_compliance) AS sla_breach_pct FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT
  "date" AS time,
  links_down
FROM public.data_sample
WHERE $__timeFilter("date")
ORDER BY "date" DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS ticket_aging_hrs FROM iceberg.noc.tickets GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC;
SELECT date AS time, iot_attach_success_rate FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, iot_device_availability FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT
  "date" AS time,
  mttr
FROM public.data_sample
WHERE $__timeFilter("date")
ORDER BY "date" DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT date AS time, smsc_traffic FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, sites_85_prb AS "Sites" FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date AS time, transport_links_80_util AS "Links" FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date_trunc('hour', metric_timestamp) AS time, avg(metric_value) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'cpu_utilization' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC;
SELECT date AS time, core_cpu_75 AS "Core CPU > 75" FROM public.data_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, count(*) AS threat_score FROM iceberg.noc.security_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC;
SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, count(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.alarms GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC;
